verdict.rationale: LocalAI's getting-started docs show a first-party CLI command that pulls a GGUF model straight from a Hugging Face repo by URI and runs it, which covers both the download and the run parts of the story. Support for other model sources (the built-in gallery and ollama:// URIs) shows the run command accepts remote model references generally. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the Hugging Face integration (supported formats beyond GGUF, gated or private repo authentication, file selection), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the huggingface:// flow works.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face
